prologue.skytest.title: Vision
prologue.skytest.line1: Cast off the shackles of sleep.
prologue.skytest.line2: The time has come for you to ascend.
prologue.skytest.line3: Find me at the top of the world.
area.skytest.lower_prison.subtitle: The very bottom of the world
area.skytest.test_end.subtitle: Test area complete. To be continued...
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.1: Hush... Don't get up so fast.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.2: You slept a long time. Longer than anyone I have ever kept here.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.3: You needn't answer. I know words were not given to you.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.4: But your eyes speak. The light came to you in your sleep, didn't it?
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.5: It only speaks to those who are meant to rise.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.awakening.6: Catch your breath. When you're ready, come to me again.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.1: This is the Lower Prison. The very bottom of the world.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.2: They throw down here those whom the world above wants to forget. Throw them down, and forget.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.3: No one has ever climbed out. I have watched them try.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.prison.4: You're looking up... So you've decided. Very well. Listen closely.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.1: Your door is not locked. I saw to that. Don't ask what it cost me.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.2: In the open cell down the corridor lie old boots.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.3: Their owner once danced beneath the circus dome. He won't need them anymore.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.4: Past the corridor is a great hall. On the ledge lies a bone hand on a chain.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.path.5: It will help you cling to life. Quite literally.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.farewell.1: Go. My light will wait for you here.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.farewell.2: If you lose your way, come back to it.
